title: CORE-7041 · SHARED: FAQ question text column 16px narrow — VERIFIED, does not reproduce
body:
**Linear:** [CORE-7041](https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-7041)

## Verdict: does NOT reproduce — no code change

Full measurements: `reports/T19-verification.md`.

The clone's FAQ trigger row is identical to live to the pixel at 1920/1440/1280/1200/1100/1023/992/900, and all 18 questions on `/faqs/directors` render at the same width and line count at 1440/768/360. Both FAQ container variants (`panel` with `px-[63px]`, and `pagePanel`) were covered across 5 page templates. The answer column matches too (1170x99 @1440, 949x99 @1024).

Only difference found anywhere: a 1px left offset at 1024 — sub-pixel rounding, not 16px.

Recommend closing the ticket as not reproducible; if the reporter still sees it, we need the exact page URL and viewport.
acceptanceCriteria: Measure the FAQ question column on live vs clone across breakpoints in a headed browser.
Cover both FAQ container variants (service/package pages and FAQ topic pages).
Either fix a real 16px inset, or record a reproducible-with/not-reproducible verdict with numbers.
